title: Organization types
description: Governed primary types for public, commercial, research, humanitarian and agricultural organizations.
governanceNotes: The first schema will store one primary OrganizationType per Organization. This is an initial modeling constraint, not a claim that an organization can have only one role forever.
A future many-to-many OrganizationTypeAssignment model is reserved for approved multi-role organization classification.

terms.label: Government agency
terms.definition: A national or subnational organization exercising public administrative, regulatory or service authority.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include ministries, departments and agencies; exclude intergovernmental bodies and government-owned commercial companies.

terms.label: Intergovernmental organization
terms.definition: An organization established by agreement among sovereign states.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include United Nations and comparable treaty-based bodies; exclude nongovernmental networks operating internationally.

terms.label: Research institution
terms.definition: An organization whose primary function includes systematic research and knowledge production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include independent and public research institutes; use UNIVERSITY where degree-granting education is primary.

terms.label: University
terms.definition: A degree-granting higher-education institution with teaching and research functions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include universities and equivalent higher-education institutions; exclude research institutes without a primary education mandate.

terms.label: Non-governmental organization
terms.definition: A nonprofit organization independent of direct government control and not established by treaty.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include civil-society and development NGOs; use HUMANITARIAN_ORGANIZATION where emergency relief is the defining role.

terms.label: Humanitarian organization
terms.definition: An organization primarily delivering humanitarian protection, relief or emergency assistance.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include relief-focused entities regardless of legal form; exclude development organizations without a primary humanitarian mandate.

terms.label: Media organization
terms.definition: An organization whose primary function is producing or distributing journalism and public-information content.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include commercial and public-service news publishers; exclude institutional communications offices whose primary function is not media.

terms.label: Farm
terms.definition: An organization or operating entity directly conducting agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include commercial and institutional farm operators; individual farm records remain owned by the Flaha Knowledge Platform.

terms.label: Cooperative
terms.definition: A member-owned organization formed to provide services, bargaining or market access to participants.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include producer and rural cooperatives; exclude investor-owned agribusinesses.

terms.label: Agribusiness
terms.definition: A commercial organization operating across agricultural production, inputs, processing or distribution.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use where no more specific primary organization type applies; exclude farms and specialist input suppliers when those define the organization.

terms.label: Input supplier
terms.definition: A commercial organization primarily supplying agricultural inputs or equipment.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include seed, fertilizer, protection, feed and machinery suppliers; exclude general retailers without an agricultural-input focus.

terms.label: Food processor
terms.definition: An organization primarily transforming agricultural materials into food ingredients or products.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include processing and food manufacturing companies; exclude farms and retail-only businesses.

terms.label: Trading company
terms.definition: A commercial organization primarily buying, selling or intermediating goods across markets.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include agricultural and commodity traders; exclude exchanges and logistics providers that do not take a trading role.

terms.label: Market operator
terms.definition: An organization operating a physical or electronic venue for exchange.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include exchanges, wholesale markets and auction operators; exclude traders participating in those markets.

terms.label: Logistics provider
terms.definition: An organization primarily providing transport, storage, cold-chain or distribution services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include carriers, warehouse operators and freight services; exclude traders whose logistics are incidental.

terms.label: Financial institution
terms.definition: An organization providing banking, insurance, investment, credit or payment services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include regulated and development-finance institutions; exclude grantmaking programs without an institutional financial role.

terms.label: Technology provider
terms.definition: An organization primarily developing or supplying technology products or technical platforms.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include agricultural and general technology vendors; exclude research-only institutions without a supplied technology offering.

terms.label: Sports organization
terms.definition: An organization governing, organizing or operating competitive sport.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include federations, leagues, clubs and tournament bodies; exclude general public-event organizers without a sport mandate.

terms.label: Public institution
terms.definition: A publicly established institution that is not primarily an administrative government agency.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include public authorities, boards and public-service institutions; prefer GOVERNMENT_AGENCY where direct administration or regulation is primary.

terms.label: Energy company
terms.definition: A commercial or state-owned organization primarily producing, distributing or selling energy.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include fuel and power companies; exclude agricultural businesses merely consuming energy.
